ov: Large marine crustaceans with long bodies, muscular tails and big front claws, highly prized as seafood. They have blue blood, from copper-based haemocyanin.

why.ac: It stays in its burrow by day and wanders the sea floor at night.
why.et: Usually boiled or steamed in the shell and eaten with butter and lemon.

df: Live prey such as fish, molluscs, other crustaceans and worms, plus some plants. They scavenge if they need to.

cf.tip: Freshwater crayfish are among the lobster’s closest living relatives.
